outcome: Neonatal admission to Intensive Care Unit
cohort: 1096 pregnancies (355 in women with endometriosis and 741 in women without endometriosis) from eleven Italian referral centers
finding: Women with endometriosis who conceive naturally have increased risk of preterm delivery and neonatal admission to intensive care unit.
mod_finding: Women with endometriosis and severe adenomyosis may be at increased risk of placenta previa and cesarean delivery.
